title: Scenarios: choose the question
intro: The Scenarios tab starts with the questions that the built-in farm can answer: water, nitrogen, climate, a chemical and soil. Two more cards lead to your own set-up and to two tools that need no Daisy program.

marks.d: Does irrigation pay off, and what does it cost the soil.
How much fertiliser, how much leaching.
A warmer, drier or wetter climate.
Sorption and degradation of a pesticide or tracer.
Run a set-up of your own or draw the figures of logs you loaded.
A built-in tool that needs no Daisy program.
A built-in tool that draws any Daisy function.
